name: Post Order Master – Free Drag & Drop Hierarchy Manager
author: Yalogica

sections.description:
Effortlessly sort your posts, pages, and even custom post types! 🚀 This free plugin offers a clean, intuitive interface where you can select your desired post type, load its items, and rearrange them via a simple drag & drop operation. Build hierarchical trees of content to reflect your site’s structure exactly as you envision!

✨ With Post Order Master you can:

✅ Sort content using a highly responsive drag & drop interface 🔄
✅ Organize posts, pages, and custom post types into a clear hierarchical tree structure 🌳
✅ Enhance your site’s UX by crafting a custom display order that highlights your best content 💡
✅ Save time with an intuitive UI that needs zero complex configurations ⏱️

✨ Why Post Order Master?

Over time, managing your content order with default WordPress sorting can be challenging. Post Order Master resolves these issues by offering a fully manual, yet simple, drag and drop sorting experience. Reinforce your SEO strategy, drive more engaged visitors and polish your content presentation with our dynamic plugin!

🔐 Plugin Respects User Permissions

The plugin is “capabilities aware” — only users who have the right to edit others’ pages, posts (such as editors and administrators) will be able to reorder content. 👨‍💻

🚀 COMPATIBILITY

We realize that not all themes and plugins have the same structure and as a result are different, so we strive to provide additional compatibility. Post Order Master seamlessly integrates and works with the most popular WordPress page builders, themes and plugins. In rare cases, if Post Order Master fails to work with any page builder, theme or plugin, simply post in the support forum and we will do our best to resolve the issue.

PAGE BUILDERS
* Gutenberg – modern built-in WordPress block editor
* Classic Editor – classic built-in WordPress editor
* Elementor – leading website builder platform on WordPress
* WP Bakery – create any layout with intuitive way
* Beaver – page builder you can trust with your business
* Bricks – amazing block editor with many templates
* Brizy – next-gen website builder that anyone can use
* and more…

🎓 CONCLUSION

Transform your WordPress content management experience with the Post Order Master plugin. Simplify your post organization, enhance efficiency, and take control of your content like never before. This plugin provides an intuitive drag & drop interface, allowing you to easily rearrange, manage, and build a hierarchical tree for your standard and custom posts. Effortlessly reorder posts, pages, and custom post types, keeping your website organized and SEO-friendly. Each custom ordering gives your site a polished look and ensures visitors find what they need quickly. Try Post Order Master today and unlock the full potential of your WordPress website!

💼 GDPR & Privacy

  • We do not collect or store any information about our visitors or users without their consent.
  • We also do not transfer any data to external servers without users’ consent.
  • The purpose of our plugin is to help organize the WordPress pages, posts, and custom post types.

Support

Found an issue or have a feature request? Head over to our support forum or drop us an email for assistance. We’re here to help you master your post order effortlessly!
sections.installation:
1. Download the latest version of Post Order Master from the WordPress plugin repository.
  2. Upload the extracted folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it directly via the WordPress dashboard.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  4. Visit the Post Order Master settings page and choose your desired post type to start reordering.
sections.faq:
How do I reorder my posts?

Simply navigate to the designated post type in the plugin admin area, items will be loaded automaticaly, then use the drag & drop interface to reorder or create hierarchies. Save your changes! 👍

Is Post Order Master free?

Absolutely! Post Order Master is a completely free plugin designed to improve your content management experience without any cost. Enjoy premium features without spending a dime! 🎉

Will my custom order apply on the front end?

Yes! Once arranged, simply ensure your theme or custom queries use the ‘menu_order’ parameter to display your sorted content.
